label: PF Backlog 97
title: Backend: design-spec diagram rendering - tagged mermaid fences -> draw.io source -> SVG/PDF
body:
The per-feature spec must emit diagrams as TAGGED ```mermaid fences (stateDiagram-v2, sequenceDiagram, erDiagram, flowchart) and the pipeline must render them to draw.io source (.drawio) and SVG/PDF (derived artifacts, BI-0087). Use core/architecture_diagram.py + pipeline.pdf_generator; write derived diagrams under products/

/artifacts// (e.g. design-spec.diagrams.drawio, design-spec.diagrams.pdf). Also fix spec Links to use explicit FR-/NFR-/US- ids. [OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] DIAGRAM RENDERING MUST SUCCEED. Diagrams in specs MUST actually render to .drawio/SVG/PDF. The observed "[DIAGRAMS] ... 0 rendered via unavailable" (renderer unavailable) is unacceptable: either make the renderer available or the stage must still emit drawio/svg/pdf.

decisions.note: Diagram rendering: renderer-unavailable is unacceptable; must emit .drawio/SVG/PDF
